The '''''Seniag''''' was an [[Action VI bulk transport/Legends|Action VI bulk transport]] owned and operated by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] as of [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].

The Seniag was in dry dock at the [[Kothlis II]] platform near [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] attacked in order to retrieve stolen plans on the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]]. The vessel was presumably supposed to evacuate base personnel, but never actually left the site.

==Behind the scenes==
As aforementioned, the Seniag spends the entire level parked above Kothlis II and doesn't do anything, unlike the three [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transports]] nearby that do eventually flee the site. The reason for the vessel's presence at all in the game is thus questionable.
